prompts.prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve. Asset type: production transparent 2D desktop-pet animation atlas, sheet A.
Input image 1 is the sole character identity reference, a front/side/back model sheet. Preserve the same silver-white long wavy hair with ahoge, segmented pale dragon horns, purple eyes, pointed ears, asymmetric braided silver knot hair ornament and tassel, small pale lavender bat-like wings, thick white scaled curled tail, ornate layered white off-shoulder gown, delicate silver jewelry and white shoes. Keep her chibi proportions, soft detailed anime illustration and original colors. This is a cute adult fantasy character, neutral/nonsexual.
Create ONE square 2048 by 2048 PNG RGBA sprite atlas with a genuinely TRANSPARENT background, EXACT regular 4-column by 4-row grid of sixteen equally sized 512x512 cells. No grid lines, labels, text, captions, watermark, ground, checkerboard pixels or contact shadows. Each cell contains exactly ONE complete full-body version of the same character; do NOT redraw the three-view reference layout.
All 16 poses face forward toward the viewer. The character is centered at the same x=256 within every cell, head including horns around y=30, soles at exactly y=480; keep all wings/hair/tail inside each individual cell with 24px safe margins, same scale and stable foot anchor. No overlap across cells, no cropped horns/feet. Fixed orthographic camera. Preserve all costume details consistently; only the specified animation gestures vary.
Read frames LEFT TO RIGHT, then TOP TO BOTTOM:
Row 1 IDLE (four seamless looping frames): relaxed standing, eyes open; gentle breath and eyelids half lowered; full blink with both eyelids closed; eyes open again with slight tail-tip sway. Changes are small, torso and feet stable.
Row 2 SPEAKING (four frames): friendly face with closed mouth; small open-mouth speech; mouth wider open while talking; small smile closing mouth. Feet/hair scale stable, only mouth and very slight head gesture.
Row 3 THINKING (four frames): one hand near chin, curious thoughtful gaze; eyes glance slightly up; gentle head tilt with blink; return close to first thinking pose. No thought icons.
Row 4 WAITING FOR USER ANSWER (four frames): gently curious expression and one open hand asking a question; small questioning head tilt; soft blink in that same pose; eyes open and return. No drawn bubble, no question marks.
This must be usable as four frame-based animations with rigorous row/column alignment. Transparent antialiased edges, high fidelity to the provided identity, clean readable silhouette at small desktop size.

Use case: identity-preserve. Asset type: transparent desktop-pet animation atlas, sheet B.
Input 1 is the original three-view identity master. Input 2 is the already generated front-action sprite sheet; match its character scale, chibi proportions and detailed soft anime painting, but make cleaner edges. Preserve the silver-white wavy long hair, lavender eyes, segmented white horns, pointed ears, braided silver knot/tassel hair ornament, lavender small dragon wings, thick white-scaled tail, layered white formal gown and shoes. Cute adult fantasy character; neutral nonsexual presentation.
Deliver one square PNG with REAL RGBA TRANSPARENCY, an EXACT regular 4x4 grid of 16 full-body sprites. NO opaque background, NO checkerboard pattern, NO white or colored speckles/halos around figures, NO text, NO separators, NO floor/shadow, NO other objects.
Every cell must have the same generous transparent padding: keep the entire body including horns, ahoge, wings, tail and shoes within the central 78% of cell height and central 82% of width. SAME character scale and foot baseline in all cells. Do NOT crop any part; no touching cell edges. Full sprites remain separate. Consistent centered orthographic view. Source image 1 controls identity and costume.
Rows left-to-right:
Row 1 WAITING FOR APPROVAL: four small looping variations of attentive hopeful expression, hands gently together at waist then one small politely offered open hand, blink then eyes open. No icons or text, no props.
Row 2 SUCCESS: four frames of a gentle happy celebratory gesture, starting smile, small raised hands, delighted closed-eye smile, return to relaxed happy stance. Slight wing lift, feet stay on the SAME baseline.
Row 3 ERROR/NEEDS HELP: four frames of a mild puzzled apologetic expression, tiny worried head tilt, blink, look back gently at viewer. Keep this cute and calm, no tears, no symbols.
Row 4 BACK IDLE: four rear-facing idle/breath/blink-like hair/wing/tail micro-motion variations. Match the BACK view in input 1, showing complete long white wavy hair, white horns, lavender wings and scaled curled tail, gown and both shoes. Do not turn into a different character.
Clean continuous illustrated edges and stable frame-to-frame identity. This is a game-ready sprite atlas, not a character lineup or contact sheet with labels.

Use case: identity-preserve. Asset type: 2D desktop pet directional walk/run sprite atlas C.
Input 1 is the original three-view silver dragon girl, the identity and wardrobe master. Input 2 is the existing front atlas; match the same cute chibi character and drawing. Preserve silver-white wavy long hair and ahoge, segmented pale horns, violet eyes, pointed ears, silver braided knot/tassel ornament, pale lavender bat-like wings, thick curled white-scaled dragon tail, white ornate layered off-shoulder fantasy gown, white shoes, same adult fantasy character neutral/nonsexual.
Create exactly ONE square transparent PNG atlas with 4 COLUMNS and 4 ROWS, exactly 16 separately readable complete full-body sprites, fixed-size regular equal cells. TRUE TRANSPARENT BACKGROUND only; no background color or checkerboard pixels; no noise, stray dots, white debris, glow, halos, floor, contact shadows, motion lines, text, labels, cell borders or extra objects. Clean illustrated silhouette.
Same body/head scale in every frame, same ground baseline; full horns, ahoge, shoes, dress, wings and entire tail fit INSIDE each cell. Keep generous uniform transparent margins. The movement must be depicted by ACTUAL alternating leg/shoe/arm and cloth poses, not copies with translated positions.
LEFT TO RIGHT, TOP TO BOTTOM:
ROW1 WALK RIGHT: side / slight three-quarter facing RIGHT in all four frames. Frame1 rightward stride left foot ahead, right foot behind; frame2 feet passing under body; frame3 opposite stride right foot ahead, left behind; frame4 feet passing again. Natural small counter-swing of sleeves, dress hems, wings and tail. Upper body stable. Four-frame seamless loop.
ROW2 RUN RIGHT: same character facing RIGHT, playful modest forward lean, four running gait phases (contact, compression, opposite contact, passing). More energetic alternating legs, sleeves/hair/tail lag; same ground baseline and camera scale. No jumping outside cell.
ROW3 WALK LEFT: side / slight three-quarter facing LEFT, same four walk gait phases. Preserve hair accessory and garment identity, use correct visible side from original model sheet rather than inventing costume details. Loop.
ROW4 RUN LEFT: facing LEFT, matching four-phase energetic run cycle as row2. Loop.
Use small neat walking steps under gown so actual feet stay visible; never replace dress with trousers. High-quality anime coloring and silver/lavender linework faithful to reference, grid alignment is essential for runtime cropping.

Production sprite cleanup, use case precise-object-edit. The attached image is the EDIT TARGET, a 4x4 sprite atlas. Keep exactly the same sixteen silver-white dragon-girl characters, identities, all costume details, expressions, row order, body scale and complete feet/horns/tails. Do not invent new poses.
Remove every detached noise island, random white/gray dot, speckle, dust-like residue and colored magenta fringe in the transparent background. Remove white checker-like debris between sprites, leaving only each deliberate illustrated character silhouette. Preserve the silver-white hair and white gown INSIDE the silhouette. Genuinely transparent RGBA background with clean antialiased edges; no glow, shadow, background color, checkerboard, text, grid or new elements.
Respect the 4x4 rows: idle with blink / speech mouths / thinking / asking for user input. Each full body fits its own cell, centered and same scale, no cut feet or head. A clean professional game animation sheet of the reference character, with NOTHING floating in the transparent gaps.

Production cleanup of the attached 4-by-4 dragon-girl expression sprite atlas. Treat attached image as exact edit target.
Preserve all sixteen sprites, their precise identities, expressions, outfits, orientation, full-body silhouettes and row order. Row1 approval, row2 happiness, row3 puzzled/needs-help, row4 rear view. Preserve every complete horn, ahoge, wing, shoe and tail.
Remove ALL detached white, gray, pink and purple speckle/noise fragments outside the character silhouettes and reduce bright white/magenta fringe halos. All gaps outside illustrated characters must be truly TRANSPARENT RGBA alpha zero. Keep the white gown, silver-white hair and pale scales INSIDE character silhouettes unchanged. No shadows, background colors, checkerboard, labels, text or border lines.
Keep the 4x4 arrangement, same scale for every character, full figures visible inside their respective cells without overlaps. Crisp clean anime illustration asset ready for a desktop pet.

Use case: precise-object-edit / background-extraction.
EDIT TARGET: the attached directional dragon-girl sprite sheet. Production cleanup ONLY: remove ALL detached white/gray/purple/pink noise fragments, stray pixels, random dots, speckles and opaque background remnants that appear in the transparent gaps around and between the sixteen characters. Remove the bright white/magenta fringe halos outside each illustrated silhouette. Every pixel outside a deliberate character silhouette must have alpha=0. Preserve soft antialiasing on the illustrated boundary. This must have genuinely TRANSPARENT RGBA background, NOT white or a painted checkerboard.
Keep ALL SIXTEEN CHARACTERS, their poses, face, costume, details, colors and 4-by-4 placement exactly the same. Do not change character identities. Do not add text or props. Each full character must be entirely visible, including every horn, hair curl and shoe.
Additionally make this a strict equal-cell 4x4 atlas by centering each existing complete sprite inside its own cell at the SAME SCALE and SAME FOOT BASELINE, with 8 percent empty transparent padding at top and bottom; maintain the four right-walk, right-run, left-walk, left-run rows. Preserve all actual gait pose differences. Do not place any character pixels across a cell boundary. Final image square, clean alpha silhouette, zero non-character islands, no shadows.
